acceptanceCriteria: `corvint-js-test-provider e2e --help` (and the provider docs) state that results Playwright reports for dependency (setup) projects bind only when each setup file is also passed with `--test-file`, and that `--test-arg` and `--test-file` are independent.
The `test-file-unbound` / `report-identity-unknown` refusal names the unbound anchor file(s) in its detail.

Either an opt-in that binds dependency-project files Playwright reports is specified and tested, or the owner records the explicit --test-file requirement as the accepted contract; a regression test covers a setup-project run.
GitHub issue #807 is closed by the delivering PR.
body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#807 (opened 2026-10-11 by the owner while qualifying an external Playwright run with `corvint-js-test-provider e2e`).

Expected: a Playwright run whose config uses project dependencies (setup projects) binds every reported result, or the refusal says which file is unbound and the help documents the rule.
Actual: results for the setup files are refused as `report-identity-unknown` / `test-file-unbound` unless each setup file is also passed via `--test-file`, even though every result passed. `--test-arg` (what Playwright runs) and `--test-file` (what identity binds) are independent, so passing only the target spec to both is not enough. The requirement is undocumented and the refusal does not name the anchor file.

Version: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 (build 407). Related: V1-1196 (GH #794, provider help).

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#808 (GH #807 closed by the PR); on main at fb11b2274. The test-file-unbound refusal names the unbound setup-project files; corvint-js-test-provider e2e help and docs state that dependency (setup) project results bind only when each setup file is passed with --test-file and that --test-arg and --test-file are independent; the explicit --test-file requirement is the recorded contract (PWP-V0-019, accepted under the owner's standing auto-accept 2026-10-11) with a setup-project regression test. Tests: internal/jstestprovider and cmd/corvint-js-test-provider PASS on go1.27.2. full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the gh807 build-log record at the merge commit.

title: js-test-provider e2e: setup-project results refused as test-file-unbound unless each setup file is passed via --test-file (GH #807)
